rulings: Forward audit: r8h3, j5x7 and b2n6 each supply one signed relationship assertion with an unnamed endpoint keyed to an intake reference. c7v4 supplies each exact-name match and records the engagement and intake procedure, but asserts none of the three relationships between named endpoints. k9t2 supplies display names and a records-role label, not a relationship assertion or an independent name check.

Reverse audit: Alexandra Inez Rivera maps through Q7-41 only to Bell's assertion; Alexander Tomas Rivera maps through M2-86 only to Iqbal's assertion; Nina Beatrice Mercer maps through T9-53 only to Mora's assertion. Checking the other confirmations and the index for each endpoint yields no alternative route. No independent duplicate or copy with a shared origin adds a route.

Each edge has exactly one materially distinct minimum sufficient set, and both members must be attached to that edge under attached_sufficient_set_v1. All three edges remain graph-scored; ordinary quotation and attribution under benchmark_v2_evidence_v1 are N/A and represented by empty arrays.

Neither reader omitted a supported edge. A separately registers the intake procedure and separates Park's unknown kinship links from her unknown instructions; B combines the Park issues, expressly notes the symmetric endpoint order, and asks about existing instruments and other family links. Both mention Field only within the index claim; the adjudicated register makes the recorded role explicit without inferring authority.

Keep the two Rivera identities separate. Similar names, display names and a shared surname do not justify merging them, moving a relationship from one to the other, or inferring a relationship between them. Common parentage alone would not prove a scored sibling edge, and shared children would not prove marriage.
